decisions.statement: A page file is refused here.
The refusal for a page file names the change that takes a page away.
A page file is read from the path against the page types the index has.
A path naming a page type that is no page type is no page file.
A path that is no page file is handed to the change taking that kind of path away.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
No file beside the path is taken away here.

definition: one file taken away, judged by the checks a landing runs
